data.name: Druid's Tale: Crystal Cave
data.detailed_description:
Become an unconventional Druid that protects the land from the forces of darkness. Use true power of VR devices or just play with your mouse and keyboard.

Innovations and news

The game emphasizes the use of new solutions, to show players something they know in a completely different way. Do not be fooled by your habits and open your mind to new experiences.

Exploration

Explore the atmospheric world of underground caves filled with magical crystals. Discover hidden passages and secret locations filled with unique ingredients.
Collect herbs and mushrooms in an environment that lives on its own life. The flora of the land grows on the basis of how it is cared for. Each biom has its own ecosystem. Be careful not to lead to the extinction of rare herbs by interfering with the land.

Crafting

Create potions throwing various ingredients into the cauldron. Discover new recipes, refine their composition, and save them on scrolls. You can create both potions, drugs or even alcohol. Many of them have unique effects and can influence how we see the environment.

Research

Perform research and analysis of the newly found ingredients, objects or remains of enemies, discover their properties and characteristics using specialized tools.

Trade and Neutral Fractions

Trade with neutral factions to help them with their needs. Get access to the objects that don't exist in your land and maintain a relationship. The faction interacts with each other and can interfere in your land by building structures or devastating it.

Fight

Protect the world against the forces of darkness. Black spirits will haunt the land coming from its dimension. Some of them will want to take control of a fragment of your world materializing in the form of evil totems. Do not be fooled by the inconsistency of this opponent, he will slowly suck life energy out of the land and gain unique abilities that he will use to defend.
Travel to the dimension of darkness, dark place from where ghosts are attacking your world, to obtain a rare ingredients and steal their treasures.

Missions

Try out 3 completely unique mission systems where everyone will find the most suitable job for him.
  • You care for self-development? You will use the Terms
  • Want to help others? You will use Trade Treaties
  • Looking for a bigger target? Try Divine Missions!

Meditation

In free moments, meditate, cut off from the world around you, moving into your own mind, where you can catch your own thoughts or face your conscience. It is a unique system in which you will be able to create the way your character perceives the world.

VR

The game was designed to take advantage of the potential dormant in virtual reality and enhance the experience associated with it. It is based on building a deep immersion for which standard solutions and interface have been abandoned. Many aspects will benefit from the perception of the depth, the sense of spatial orientation, and the way in which the mind reacts to certain specific stimuli. However, even if you don't have VR Set, you can still play using standard PC Configuration (Monitor, Keyboard and Mouse)

Full support for Leap Motion controller!

Game is using the full potential of Leap Motion. Have you ever wanted to catch sword with your own hands or cast lightning from fingertips? This game will give you opportunity to do that, and much more!

Due to ongoing VR testing, virtual reality and Leap Motion support in the current version of the game is disabled. It will be available as soon as possible in future updates.

data.short_description: RPG game with crafting elements. Become a Druid that is protecting your land from darkness. Make potions, poisons and even alcohol. Trade your products with neutral factions and fight the forces of evil. The game emphasizes new solutions that have not been applied anywhere else!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10
  • Processador: Intel Core i3
  • Memória: 2 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: nVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 5700
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 2 GB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: Can use Leap Motion device.

reviews.review:
This game was nothing about druidism.. Just a click bait, fun the first hour and then you search for more things... =( Not worth the price tag! 
It handles worse than anything without VR set. But don't support it straight away x'D 

I wanted a refund but it was too late, I had to google and research about this game on how to decode all sigil's and marks but nothing I had to spend more time writing things down since the game was "SOO helpful" with having a in game notebook.....Best druid ever without his own notebook..

But there are NO instructions inside the game, No tutorial. No guide in the steam community..
So you start of with a briefing and rest you figure out, including how things work. How to slay the ghost for example. When he took 40 hits in his face
(Which can bug and become immortal so you need to start entire save file over from start in order to get rid of the ghost sometimes.. ) 

You are just being told things very short and bad, without more info on what things mean, and what they do.. and again (Or how the mark or sigil look like but you have to guess and have a notebook next to you irl, So you write down things more than actually playing the game....)

Impossible to sort things because when you came back for a 3 or 5'th time all your mushrooms got mixed with other stuff, and mushrooms mix with others.
What is the point to not add a track code of Item ID ?

So you need a VR set to play a game made by 1 person since moving things around is more mouse scrolling than enjoying the world outside that door with boring tasks written on it.

I bought this game since I am polish my self, I am a Shaman Druid and a coder also.
But to see this that gives motion sickness, and Claustrophobia due to a super small world to play in. But now I regret it and steam don't want to refund. 

This game is fun first 20 minutes.. but as soon as you try to use the sword and it bugs soon and fly's away from your hand. 

This game ain't worth what they creator ask for, This teaches you VERY little or nothing about the druidic path. (I would hope it would go through basics which is ALOT of Animism and Shamanic knowledge before brewing potions..)

The 11 hours I spent on this game was not worth it as for 11 hours of meditation taught me much more while having contact with a spirit guide. this game didn't even offer teaching you on how you gain connection with other worlds, how to meditate wasn't even taught... 
This game is a joke on it's name and what it could have been. 

(Like it was hard to create a spirit guide that manifest's from like 8 or 12 different animals (power animals!) and this guide will show the druid how to find things, what certain things mean and can happen, Even working as a companion for company.)
